commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+2' The booking goes to Yellu Santiago (Getafe).
90+1' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Jaime Mata (Getafe) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
86' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
86' Jordi Martin (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
82' A corner kick by Almeria is thwarted by the well prepared David Soria (Getafe).
80' Here is a change. Cesar Montes is going off and Pepe Mel gives the last tactical orders to Luka Romero (Almeria).
80' Here comes a substitution. Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Jose Angel Carmona.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alberto Risco Alcantara (Getafe) comes onto the pitch so that Luis Milla can be given a rest.
79' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the right side of the goal, but David Soria denies him.
79' Jonathan Viera (Almeria) will take the free kick.
78' Luis Milla (Getafe) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Almeria have a free kick.

77' Edgar Gonzalez (Almeria) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Guillermo Cuadra with no other option than to blow for a foul.
77' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
76' Bruno Langa (Almeria) was close to scoring after he unleashed a powerful shot which went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
74' Sergio Arribas (Almeria) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
74' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle after Adrian Embarba (Almeria) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
74' Almeria take a short corner kick.
74' The referee awards a corner and Adrian Embarba (Almeria) goes over to take it.
71' Almeria work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
71' Almeria quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

70' Marc Pubill (Almeria) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Good work from Almeria as they win a corner.
70' Pepe Mel has decided to substitute Leo Baptistao and he is replaced by Marcos Pena (Almeria).

69' Choco Lozano (Almeria) rifles a low drive from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic reflex save.
68' The referee signals a substitution. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Ilaix Moriba.
67' A player from Almeria commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
67' Almeria will take a corner kick.
66' Choco Lozano (Almeria) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Almeria have a corner.
64' 10:8 – the total goal attempt statistics. The number of shots on goal at present is 8:5.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Robertone departs the field of play to be replaced by Sergio Arribas (Almeria).
61' 1 - 3 Goal! Mason Greenwood tees up Jaime Mata (Getafe) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the middle of the goal. 1:3.
60' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) has tested the patience of referee Guillermo Cuadra and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
57' The attendance for today's match is 7874.
57' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Jordi Martin (Getafe) replaces Oscar Rodriguez.
55' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) will miss the next game.
55' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Guillermo Cuadra had an easy-decision to make.
54' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game. One of the players from Almeria won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
54' The free kick from long range, taken by Almeria, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Adrian Embarba (Almeria) for his blatant foul.
48' 1 - 2 Goal! Mason Greenwood (Getafe) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:2.
48' Luis Maximiano blocks a long-range effort from Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) towards the middle of the goal.
46' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
46' Half-time substitution. Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) will not participate anymore and Jaime Mata is coming on.
46' Pepe Mel makes a switch. Edgar Gonzalez is coming on in place of Dion Lopy (Almeria) at the start of the second period.
46' The whistle blows and Guillermo Cuadra starts the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' Djene (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
41' 1 - 1 Goal! Choco Lozano (Almeria) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 1:1.
40' A player from Getafe commits a rough challenge. Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
38' Cesar Montes (Almeria) has tested the patience of referee Guillermo Cuadra and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
36' Almeria take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
36' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Getafe is cautioned for aggressive play.
34' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the free kick and attempts to find some of his teammates inside the box, but the ball is intercepted and cleared out of danger.
33' A player from Almeria commits a rough challenge. Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
32' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the David Soria anticipates well and smothers the ball.
29' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Almeria was in an offside position.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Mason Greenwood (Getafe), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:1.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Omar Alderete (Getafe) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
23' A player from Almeria commits a rough challenge. Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
22' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 0:3. Shots on target – 0:1.
19' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
19' Bruno Langa (Almeria) is able to continue to play.
17' Bruno Langa (Almeria) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
14' The Getafe players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Omar Alderete (Getafe) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
11' Dion Lopy (Almeria) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game. One of the players from Getafe won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.

9' Omar Alderete (Getafe) unleashed a poor free kick shot from far out. He intended to threaten the goalkeeper, but instead sent the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Almeria.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Dion Lopy (Almeria) was too aggressive in his challenge. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.

5' Djene (Getafe) misses a big chance from point-blank range as he struck the ball towards the middle of the goal. His promising effort following the corner kick was, to his disappointment, thwarted by Luis Maximiano with a fabulous save.
5' The ball goes out of play. Getafe are awarded a corner kick.
4' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Guillermo Cuadra stops the game and makes a call.
3' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Getafe will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
3' The Getafe players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Getafe will kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra is the one to supervise the game today.
